div.div:
Mechanically identical to Pattern 005's GitOps flow — only the resource definitions change.
Every Grafana Cloud resource (Stack, Folder, RBAC, LBAC, Notification Policy) is declared as code.
Reverting a configuration is a git revert.
No manual UI clicks. Ever.
